description_en: Starts an image creation task for an existing image version, or resumes an existing creation task
description_zh: 为已有镜像版本启动制作任务，或恢复已有制作任务
name: StartTaskForCreateImage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image. This parameter is not exposed by default
parameters.help_zh: 指定镜像ID，默认不对外暴露
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The image version. This parameter is currently not exposed
parameters.help_zh: 指定镜像版本，暂不对外暴露
parameters.name: version_id

parameters.help_en: The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GB
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The list of resources required for image creation, such as the download URLs of applications to be installed. You can specify up to 100 items. The ResourceType and Resource of each item must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 镜像制作所需的资源列表，例如待安装应用的下载地址。最多 100 项；每项的 ResourceType 与 Resource 必须相互对应
parameters.name: resource_list

parameters.help_en: The WUYING instance ID. The instance can be a cloud desktop instance or a workstation instance. To ensure data consistency in the image, stop the instance before initiating image creation
parameters.help_zh: 无影实例ID。该实例可以是云桌面实例，工作站实例。为了保障镜像中的数据数据一致性， 建议将实例关机之后再发起镜像制作
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The sub-instance ID. This parameter is not applicable to cloud desktop scenarios. In workstation scenarios, pass the persistent session ID to ensure that a specific instance is located
parameters.help_zh: 子实例ID，云电脑场景不涉及。工作站场景，需要传入持久会话ID，确保定位到一个具体的实例
parameters.name: sub_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The image creation mode. Currently, use the following mode:

BUILDER_MANUAL: Manually enter the creation environment to install applications and configure the image
parameters.help_zh:
镜像制作模式。当前请使用以下模式：

BUILDER_MANUAL：手动进入制作环境安装应用并配置镜像
parameters.name: image_create_mode

parameters.help_en:
The running mode of the image creation environment. Valid values:

NORMAL: Normal running mode.
COMPATIBLE: Compatible running mode
parameters.help_zh:
镜像制作环境的运行模式。可选值：

NORMAL：普通运行模式。
COMPATIBLE：兼容运行模式
parameters.name: run_mode

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Set this parameter to the following fixed value when you call the operation:

CloudApp: WUYING Cloud App
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。调用时固定填写以下取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The source region where the image is created. If you do not specify this parameter, a region is randomly selected
parameters.help_zh: 指定创建镜像的源地域，不设置则随机选择
parameters.name: source_region

Code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request is processed successfully. Other values indicate that the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务状态码。`200` 表示请求处理成功；其他值表示处理失败

Message.description_en: The error message returned when an error occurs

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
